title: Vendored GGML Tensor Library with C-Callable Compute API
text: generated, pinned subset GGML: tensor/context/graph core, official gguf.cpp reader writer, tensor-level quantize/dequantize, CPU kernels, BLAS backend, opt-Vulkan CUDA sources. See inst/COPYRIGHTS tools/vendor-ggml/PROVENANCE.md exact recipe. native R targets, GGML’s BLAS backend (-DGGML_USE_BLAS) offloads F32 mul_mat whatever BLAS R build links (reference libRblas, OpenBLAS, MKL, Accelerate, …) - BLAS interface universal native R, needs extra system dependency. GGML’s BLAS backend written C cblas_sgemm interface, R guarantee (R guarantees Fortran sgemm_); Rggml bridges gap small portable shim (inst/ggml/cblas.h + rggml_cblas.c) forwards cblas_sgemm Fortran sgemm_ via R’s F77_NAME() convention, linking $(BLAS_LIBS) $(FLIBS). webR omits bridge flang ABI adds hidden character-length arguments match native R ABI. Dense products remain available GGML’s CPU backend, backend capability difference rather missing operation. GGML’s supported CPU-WebAssembly shape, using wasm SIMD kernels requiring WebGPU backend; see upstream WebAssembly discussion. quantized dequant-dot path BLAS cover architecture-aware. aarch64, GGML’s complete NEON kernel set mandatory baseline. wasm uses GGML’s official SIMD128 quant kernels. x86, hot kernels compiled configure ISA-specific variants, beginning q4_K x q8_K -mavx2 -mfma -O3; CPUID dispatcher (tools/simd/) picks best runtime otherwise uses GGML’s scalar reference. follows RsimdDispatch strategy: ISA flags live configure, never R’s recorded package flags, R CMD check raises “non-portable flags” NOTE, variant ever called ISA confirmed runtime (single ., dlopen). x86 AVX2 q4_K dot measures ~6-7x faster scalar reference. (GGML’s GGML_CPU_ALL_VARIANTS deliberately used: requires GGML_BACKEND_DL + separate per-variant shared libraries loaded via dlopen, fit single-.CRAN package.) GGML tree generated, mystery copy: tools/vendor-ggml/ monorepo selects 479 files official GGML v0.16.0 commit 524f974bb21a, verifies paths contents, applies small local patch set, lets CI derive tree . Core, BLAS, GGUF, CPU, Vulkan CUDA therefore move one engine. ggmlR-derived component left MIT-licensed R-safe diagnostic shim. See inst/COPYRIGHTS tools/vendor-ggml/PROVENANCE.md complete derivation.
